Record Class CachedFile

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.http.server.types.files.CachedFile
Record Components:
content - The content, never modified
mediaType - The media type
lastModified - The last-modified time
All Implemented Interfaces:
MediaTypeProvider, CustomizableResponseType, FileCustomizableResponseType
@Internal public record CachedFile(byte[] content, MediaType mediaType, long lastModified) extends Record implements FileCustomizableResponseType
A static resource served from the in-memory cache.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
